name: Brute-force logon attempts against SAP dialog users
description: Repeated failed SAP GUI logons for one or many users from the same terminal, the classic password-guessing pattern. Security Audit Log message AU2 carries a reason code (1 = unknown user / wrong password) that distinguishes guessing from user error.
sample_log:
2026-10-27T14:22:31Z host=sapprd01 sid=PRD inst=00 client=100 user=J.DOE msgid=AU2 class=Logon sev=Critical term=10.14.22.87 tcode=SESSION_MANAGER prog=SAPMSSY1 msg="Logon failed (reason=1, type=A, client=100, user=J.DOE)"
2026-10-27T14:22:33Z host=sapprd01 sid=PRD inst=00 client=100 user=J.DOE msgid=AU2 class=Logon sev=Critical term=10.14.22.87 tcode=SESSION_MANAGER prog=SAPMSSY1 msg="Logon failed (reason=1, type=A, client=100, user=J.DOE)"
2026-10-27T14:22:36Z host=sapprd01 sid=PRD inst=00 client=100 user=J.DOE msgid=AU2 class=Logon sev=Critical term=10.14.22.87 tcode=SESSION_MANAGER prog=SAPMSSY1 msg="Logon failed (reason=1, type=A, client=100, user=J.DOE)"
detection: msgid=AU2 grouped by term/source IP: >= 10 events in 5 min, or >= 5 distinct users from one terminal in 10 min.

name: User locked by the system after repeated failed logons
description: SAP locks a user automatically once login/fails_to_user_lock is exceeded. The lock event is the confirmed outcome of a guessing attack and should be alerted on even when the individual AU2 events were below threshold.
sample_log: 2026-10-27T14:23:02Z host=sapprd01 sid=PRD client=100 user=J.DOE msgid=AUM class=Logon sev=Critical term=10.14.22.87 msg="User J.DOE locked in client 100 after too many failed logon attempts"
detection: Alert on every msgid=AUM. Correlate backwards 15 min for the AU2 burst and the source terminal.

name: Successful logon immediately after a failed-logon burst
description: A successful AU1 for the same user and terminal that just produced a run of AU2 failures is the signature of a brute-force that succeeded. This is the single highest-value authentication correlation in SAP.
sample_log:
2026-10-27T14:24:06Z host=sapprd01 sid=PRD client=100 user=J.DOE msgid=AU2 class=Logon sev=Critical term=10.14.22.87 msg="Logon failed (reason=1, type=A, client=100, user=J.DOE)"
2026-10-27T14:24:19Z host=sapprd01 sid=PRD client=100 user=J.DOE msgid=AU1 class=Logon sev=Non-Critical term=10.14.22.87 tcode=SESSION_MANAGER msg="Logon successful (type=A, client=100, user=J.DOE)"
detection: Sequence: >= 5 x AU2 then 1 x AU1 for the same user+terminal within 10 min.

name: Logon with SAP standard or default account (SAP*, DDIC, EARLYWATCH)
description: SAP ships well-known accounts with documented default passwords. Any interactive logon by SAP*, DDIC or EARLYWATCH in production is either an unmanaged emergency action or an attacker using a default credential.
sample_log: 2026-10-27T02:14:55Z host=sapprd01 sid=PRD client=000 user=SAP* msgid=AU1 class=Logon sev=Non-Critical term=203.0.113.45 tcode=SESSION_MANAGER msg="Logon successful (type=A, client=000, user=SAP*)"
detection: msgid in (AU1,AU5) AND user in (SAP*,DDIC,EARLYWATCH,SAPCPIC,TMSADM) AND system is production.

name: Interactive dialog logon by a technical or service account
description: Accounts typed SYSTEM / COMMUNICATION / SERVICE (RFC users, TMSADM, SAPCPIC, interface users) should never produce a type=A dialog logon. A dialog logon means the credential has been lifted out of its interface and is being driven by a human.
sample_log: 2026-10-27T21:48:02Z host=sapprd01 sid=PRD client=100 user=RFC_MIDDLEWARE msgid=AU1 class=Logon sev=Non-Critical term=10.14.55.12 tcode=SESSION_MANAGER prog=SAPMSSY1 msg="Logon successful (type=A, client=100, user=RFC_MIDDLEWARE)"
detection: msgid=AU1 AND type=A AND user IN (asset list of SYSTEM/COMMUNICATION/SERVICE users from USR02.USTYP).

name: Logon from an unexpected country or untrusted network range
description: SAP dialog and Fiori access normally originates from known corporate ranges and jump hosts. A successful logon sourced from a hosting provider, VPN exit or unexpected country indicates credential theft.
log_sources: SAP ICM / Web Dispatcher Access Log
sample_log: 2026-10-27T03:02:41Z host=sapprd01 sid=PRD client=100 user=F.MUELLER msgid=AU1 class=Logon sev=Non-Critical term=203.0.113.45 tcode=SESSION_MANAGER msg="Logon successful (type=A, client=100, user=F.MUELLER)"
detection: Enrich terminal/source IP with geo + ASN. Alert when country not in allow-list, or ASN is a hosting/VPN provider.

name: Same user logged on concurrently from multiple terminals
description: Two active sessions for one user ID from different source addresses means either account sharing or a stolen credential in parallel use. Both are reportable in an SAP control environment.
sample_log:
2026-10-27T09:11:04Z host=sapprd01 sid=PRD client=100 user=A.SCHMIDT msgid=AU1 class=Logon sev=Non-Critical term=10.14.22.19 msg="Logon successful (type=A, client=100, user=A.SCHMIDT)"
2026-10-27T09:13:52Z host=sapprd02 sid=PRD client=100 user=A.SCHMIDT msgid=AU1 class=Logon sev=Non-Critical term=10.88.4.230 msg="Logon successful (type=A, client=100, user=A.SCHMIDT)"
detection: Same user, >= 2 distinct terminals within 15 min, no intervening AUC logoff.

name: Password reset of a privileged account by an administrator
description: An admin resetting another user's password is normal service desk work, but a reset of a SAP_ALL holder, a basis admin or a firefighter ID is a takeover primitive and must be reconciled against a ticket.
sample_log: 2026-10-27T16:40:12Z host=sapprd01 sid=PRD client=100 user=BASIS_OP1 msgid=AUD class=User Master sev=Critical term=10.14.9.7 tcode=SU01 msg="User master record BASIS_ADMIN changed (password reset, productive password set)"
detection: msgid=AUD with password attribute changed AND target user in privileged-account watchlist AND no matching change ticket.

name: Burst of failed RFC / CPIC logons
description: AU6 records failed non-dialog logons. A burst means something is replaying stale or guessed interface credentials, often a scanner enumerating RFC destinations or a decommissioned interface still pointed at production.
sample_log:
2026-10-27T11:07:18Z host=sapprd01 sid=PRD client=100 user=RFC_SCAN msgid=AU6 class=RFC Logon sev=Critical term=203.0.113.77 msg="RFC/CPIC logon failed, reason=1, type=F, client=100, user=RFC_SCAN"
2026-10-27T11:07:19Z host=sapprd01 sid=PRD client=100 user=RFC_TEST msgid=AU6 class=RFC Logon sev=Critical term=203.0.113.77 msg="RFC/CPIC logon failed, reason=1, type=F, client=100, user=RFC_TEST"
detection: msgid=AU6: >= 10 in 5 min from one terminal, or >= 5 distinct users from one terminal.

name: Unlock of a locked user followed by immediate logon
description: An attacker with user-administration rights can unlock a dormant or locked account, use it, and re-lock it. The AUA unlock followed quickly by AU1 and privileged activity is the tell.
sample_log:
2026-10-27T22:05:33Z host=sapprd01 sid=PRD client=100 user=BASIS_OP1 msgid=AUA class=User Master sev=Critical tcode=SU01 msg="User DORMANT_FI01 unlocked in client 100"
2026-10-27T22:06:47Z host=sapprd01 sid=PRD client=100 user=DORMANT_FI01 msgid=AU1 class=Logon sev=Non-Critical term=10.14.22.87 msg="Logon successful (type=A, client=100, user=DORMANT_FI01)"
detection: msgid=AUA then AU1 for the unlocked user within 60 min, especially outside business hours.

name: Logon by an account dormant for more than 90 days
description: Dormant accounts are the preferred landing point for an attacker because nobody is watching them. Reactivation after a long silence, especially with privileged roles attached, warrants verification with the owner.
sample_log: 2026-10-27T13:30:08Z host=sapprd01 sid=PRD client=100 user=T.BECKER msgid=AU1 class=Logon sev=Non-Critical term=10.14.31.66 msg="Logon successful (type=A, client=100, user=T.BECKER)"  # last_logon_before=2026-06-14
detection: Join AU1 against USR02.TRDAT (last logon) or a SIEM-side first-seen baseline; alert when gap > 90 days.

name: Assignment of SAP_ALL or SAP_NEW profile
description: SAP_ALL grants every authorization in the system. Its assignment in production is the single most consequential authorization event in an SAP landscape and is almost never legitimate outside a controlled emergency process.
sample_log: 2026-10-27T17:12:44Z host=sapprd01 sid=PRD client=100 user=BASIS_OP1 msgid=AUB class=User Master sev=Critical tcode=SU01 msg="Authorizations for user J.DOE changed (profile SAP_ALL added)"
detection: msgid=AUB OR CDHDR objectclass=IDENTITY where added profile in (SAP_ALL, SAP_NEW, SAP_ALL_DISPLAY exempt).

name: Grant of a critical authorization object (S_DEVELOP, S_TABU_DIS, S_RZL_ADM, S_ADMI_FCD)
description: A handful of authorization objects effectively confer system control: code change, direct table maintenance, OS-level administration and system administration functions. Changes to them are higher-signal than role names, which can be renamed.
sample_log: 2026-10-27T17:25:09Z host=sapprd01 sid=PRD client=100 user=SEC_ADMIN msgid=AUB class=User Master sev=Critical tcode=PFCG msg="Authorizations for user C.WEBER changed (role Z_FI_POWER: S_DEVELOP ACTVT=02, OBJTYPE=PROG added)"
detection: Parse role/profile change documents for the critical-object list; alert on add or on ACTVT widening to 01/02/06/07.

name: User grants a role or profile to their own account
description: Self-assignment defeats four-eyes control entirely. Comparing the acting user in the audit record against the target user is a cheap, near-zero-false-positive detection.
sample_log: 2026-10-27T18:02:51Z host=sapprd01 sid=PRD client=100 user=C.WEBER msgid=AUB class=User Master sev=Critical tcode=SU01 msg="Authorizations for user C.WEBER changed (role Z_FI_PAYMENT_RELEASE added)"
detection: msgid in (AUB,AUD,AUR) AND acting_user = target_user.

name: Spike in authorization check failures (authorization probing)
description: A user systematically trying transactions or functions they are not entitled to produces a wall of AU4 / AUL failures. This is SAP's equivalent of permission enumeration and often precedes a successful privilege find.
sample_log:
2026-10-27T10:44:02Z host=sapprd01 sid=PRD client=100 user=J.DOE msgid=AU4 class=Transaction sev=Severe tcode=SE16 msg="Start of transaction SE16 failed (reason=2: missing authorization)"
2026-10-27T10:44:11Z host=sapprd01 sid=PRD client=100 user=J.DOE msgid=AU4 class=Transaction sev=Severe tcode=SM49 msg="Start of transaction SM49 failed (reason=2: missing authorization)"
2026-10-27T10:44:24Z host=sapprd01 sid=PRD client=100 user=J.DOE msgid=AU4 class=Transaction sev=Severe tcode=RZ10 msg="Start of transaction RZ10 failed (reason=2: missing authorization)"
detection: msgid in (AU4,AUL) grouped by user: >= 15 failures across >= 8 distinct tcodes/function modules in 30 min.

name: Role maintenance performed directly in production (PFCG)
description: Roles should be built in development and transported. PFCG authorization-data changes made straight in production bypass the change process and leave no transport record to review.
sample_log:
2026-10-27T18:40:17Z host=sapprd01 sid=PRD client=100 user=SEC_ADMIN msgid=AU3 class=Transaction sev=Severe tcode=PFCG msg="Transaction PFCG started"
2026-10-27T18:43:55Z host=sapprd01 sid=PRD client=100 user=SEC_ADMIN msgid=AUR class=User Master sev=Critical tcode=PFCG msg="Role Z_MM_PURCHASING changed and generated in client 100"
detection: tcode in (PFCG,SU02,SUPC,SU24) on a production SID, where system change option is not open for that namespace.
attack: T1484 Domain or Tenant Policy Modification

name: Emergency / firefighter access used outside an approved window
description: GRC Emergency Access Management issues temporary elevated IDs. Sessions opened without a valid request, or extending past the approved window, are elevated access with no accountability.
log_sources: SAP GRC Access Control (EAM Firefighter Log)
sample_log: 2026-10-27T23:14:02Z system=GRC_PRD ff_id=FF_FI_01 owner=A.SCHMIDT controller=M.KLEIN reason_code=INCIDENT request=none valid_to=2026-10-27T20:00:00Z action=LOGON target_sid=PRD client=100 status=GRANTED
detection: EAM session start with reason_code empty/none, or session timestamp outside request valid_from..valid_to.

name: Authorization profile generated or activated outside role maintenance (SU02 / SUPC)
description: Hand-built profiles in SU02 sidestep PFCG's role documentation and the usual review path. Their generation in production is a deliberate attempt to grant authorizations invisibly.
sample_log:
2026-10-27T19:02:33Z host=sapprd01 sid=PRD client=100 user=SEC_ADMIN msgid=AU3 class=Transaction sev=Severe tcode=SU02 msg="Transaction SU02 started"
2026-10-27T19:05:48Z host=sapprd01 sid=PRD client=100 user=SEC_ADMIN msgid=AUR class=User Master sev=Critical tcode=SU02 msg="Profile Z_MANUAL_ADM created in client 100"
detection: tcode in (SU02,SUPC) in production, or manual profile creation events with no originating transport.

name: Reference user assigned to inherit privileges indirectly
description: A reference user attached in SU01 (Roles tab / logon data) silently inherits that user's authorizations. It is a well-known way to grant power without touching the target user's own role assignments.
sample_log: 2026-10-27T19:30:06Z host=sapprd01 sid=PRD client=100 user=BASIS_OP1 msgid=AUD class=User Master sev=Critical tcode=SU01 msg="User master record J.DOE changed (reference user set to REF_SUPERUSER)"
detection: CDPOS on USREFUS / reference-user field change, or AUD records where reference user is non-blank.

name: Central User Administration distribution model or field attributes changed
description: SCUA / SCUM define which system is authoritative for user data. Flipping a field from Global to Local lets an attacker make local changes in production that central administration will no longer overwrite or report.
sample_log:
2026-10-27T19:55:21Z host=sapprd01 sid=PRD client=100 user=BASIS_OP1 msgid=AU3 class=Transaction sev=Severe tcode=SCUM msg="Transaction SCUM started"
2026-10-27T19:57:40Z tabname=USCUSTSYS key=PRDCLNT100 field=ROLE_DIST value_old=GLOBAL value_new=LOCAL user=BASIS_OP1 tcode=SCUM chngind=U
detection: tcode in (SCUA,SCUM,SCUG) in production, or DBTABLOG changes on USCUSTSYS / USZBVLNDSC.
attack: T1484 Domain or Tenant Policy Modification

name: New user created directly in a production client
description: Production user creation should flow from an identity process or CUA. A locally created user, especially one created outside business hours, is a persistence mechanism.
sample_log: 2026-10-27T23:41:19Z host=sapprd01 sid=PRD client=100 user=BASIS_OP1 msgid=AU7 class=User Master sev=Critical tcode=SU01 msg="User SUPPORT_TMP created in client 100"
detection: msgid=AU7 in production with no matching IdM/CUA provisioning record, or created outside 07:00-19:00 local.

name: User created and deleted within a short window (hit-and-run account)
description: Creating an account, using it, then deleting it is a deliberate attempt to destroy the subject of the audit trail. The AU7 / AU8 pair for the same user ID inside hours is unambiguous.
sample_log:
2026-10-27T23:41:19Z host=sapprd01 sid=PRD client=100 user=BASIS_OP1 msgid=AU7 class=User Master sev=Critical tcode=SU01 msg="User SUPPORT_TMP created in client 100"
2026-10-28T01:58:44Z host=sapprd01 sid=PRD client=100 user=BASIS_OP1 msgid=AU8 class=User Master sev=Critical tcode=SU01 msg="User SUPPORT_TMP deleted in client 100"
detection: msgid=AU7 followed by AU8 for the same target user within 24 h.

name: Mass user creation or mass role assignment
description: Bulk identity changes (SU10, eCATT, a custom BAPI loop) in a short window either indicate an unreviewed migration or an attacker seeding many footholds at once.
sample_log:
2026-10-28T02:10:01Z host=sapprd01 sid=PRD client=100 user=BASIS_OP1 msgid=AU3 class=Transaction sev=Severe tcode=SU10 msg="Transaction SU10 started"
2026-10-28T02:10:44Z host=sapprd01 sid=PRD client=100 user=BASIS_OP1 msgid=AUB class=User Master sev=Critical tcode=SU10 msg="Authorizations for user WH_OP_041 changed (role Z_WM_ALL added)"   # +37 identical events in 90s
detection: count(distinct target_user) by acting user for msgid in (AU7,AUB,AUD) > 20 in 15 min.

name: User validity period extended or account type changed
description: Pushing out a leaver's validity date, or converting a SERVICE user to DIALOG, quietly re-opens access that governance believes is closed.
sample_log: 2026-10-28T09:14:52Z objectclass=IDENTITY objectid=J.LEAVER changenr=0000871231 username=BASIS_OP1 udate=2026-10-28 utime=09:14:52 tcode=SU01 tabname=USR02 fname=GLTGB value_old=20261031 value_new=20271231 chngind=U
detection: CDPOS on USR02 fields GLTGB / GLTGV / USTYP; alert on extension > 30 days or USTYP change into A (dialog).

name: User master record change by an account without HR or IdM provenance
description: User administration carried out by a basis or functional account that is not the designated provisioning identity is off-process by definition and the most common finding in SAP identity audits.
sample_log: 2026-10-28T09:40:03Z host=sapprd01 sid=PRD client=100 user=MM_SUPPORT msgid=AUD class=User Master sev=Critical tcode=SU01 msg="User master record K.VOGEL changed (logon data, roles)"
detection: msgid in (AU7,AU8,AU9,AUA,AUB,AUD) AND acting_user NOT IN approved provisioning accounts.

name: Execution of a critical basis transaction in production
description: A defined list of transactions gives system-level control: SM49/SM69 (OS commands), SM59 (RFC destinations), RZ10/RZ11 (parameters), SE06/SCC4 (change options), SM30/SE16 (table maintenance). Their start in production is always worth a record.
sample_log: 2026-10-28T10:05:11Z host=sapprd01 sid=PRD client=100 user=J.DOE msgid=AU3 class=Transaction sev=Severe term=10.14.22.87 tcode=SM49 prog=SAPMSSY1 msg="Transaction SM49 started"
detection: msgid=AU3 AND tcode IN critical-transaction watchlist AND sid in production; suppress for approved basis accounts on change windows.

name: External operating system command executed from SAP (SM49 / SM69)
description: SM69 defines external commands and SM49 runs them, under the identity of the SAP service account on the host. This is a direct path from an application-layer privilege to arbitrary OS execution.
log_sources: OS / Host Logs (syslog, auditd, Windows Event Log)
sample_log:
2026-10-28T10:07:38Z host=sapprd01 sid=PRD client=100 user=J.DOE msgid=AU3 class=Transaction sev=Severe tcode=SM49 msg="Transaction SM49 started"
2026-10-28T10:08:02Z host=sapprd01 sid=PRD user=J.DOE prog=SAPLSXPT fm=SXPG_COMMAND_EXECUTE command=ZCMD_SHELL opsystem=Linux param="-c 'cat /sapmnt/PRD/global/security/rsecssfs/data/SSFS_PRD.DAT'" rc=0
detection: tcode in (SM49,SM69) or FM SXPG_COMMAND_EXECUTE / RFC_START_PROGRAM; join to host auditd exec events by sidadm.

name: Custom report executed directly via SE38 / SA38
description: Running a Z-report straight from the editor bypasses the transaction-level authorization checks that normally wrap it. Combined with a report created the same day, this is code being run outside any control.
sample_log:
2026-10-28T10:22:14Z host=sapprd01 sid=PRD client=100 user=C.WEBER msgid=AU3 class=Transaction sev=Severe tcode=SA38 msg="Transaction SA38 started"
2026-10-28T10:22:51Z host=sapprd01 sid=PRD client=100 user=C.WEBER msgid=AUW class=Transaction sev=Severe tcode=SA38 prog=Z_EXPORT_VENDOR_BANK msg="Report Z_EXPORT_VENDOR_BANK started"
detection: msgid=AUW where prog starts with Y/Z and tcode in (SE38,SA38,SE80); escalate if program created < 7 days ago (TRDIR.CDAT).

name: Background job created or modified to run under a privileged user
description: A job step's execution user is independent of who scheduled it. Scheduling a step as DDIC or a SAP_ALL holder turns the batch scheduler into a privilege escalation and persistence mechanism.
sample_log: 2026-10-28T10:45:09Z sid=PRD client=100 jobname=ZJOB_NIGHTLY_EXPORT jobcount=10451200 created_by=C.WEBER step=1 program=Z_EXPORT_VENDOR_BANK authcknam=DDIC strtdt=2026-10-29 strtlm=02:00:00 status=released
detection: TBTCP.AUTHCKNAM (step user) != TBTCO.SDLUNAME (scheduler) AND step user is privileged.

name: Existing background job reassigned to a different execution user
description: Repointing a trusted, long-standing job at a new program or user ID lets an attacker inherit the job's schedule and its privileges without creating anything new to notice.
sample_log: 2026-10-28T11:02:33Z sid=PRD client=100 jobname=SAP_REORG_SPOOL jobcount=09881004 changed_by=J.DOE field=AUTHCKNAM value_old=SAPSYS value_new=FI_POWER01 field2=PROGRAM value_old=RSPO1041 value_new=Z_FI_PAYRUN_SILENT
detection: Change to TBTCP program or AUTHCKNAM on a job not created by the changing user.

name: Client settings opened for changes (SCC4)
description: SCC4 controls whether customizing and repository objects can be changed in a client and whether cross-client changes are permitted. Opening a production client removes the technical barrier behind nearly every other change control.
sample_log:
2026-10-28T11:20:47Z host=sapprd01 sid=PRD client=100 user=BASIS_OP1 msgid=AU3 class=Transaction sev=Severe tcode=SCC4 msg="Transaction SCC4 started"
2026-10-28T11:22:05Z tabname=T000 key=100 field=CCCORACTIV value_old=2 value_new=1 field2=CCNOCLIIND value_old=3 value_new=1 user=BASIS_OP1 tcode=SCC4 chngind=U
detection: DBTABLOG on T000 (CCCORACTIV, CCNOCLIIND, CCCATEGORY) or tcode=SCC4 in production.
attack: T1484 Domain or Tenant Policy Modification

name: System change option set to modifiable (SE06 / SE03)
description: With the global setting on 'Modifiable', ABAP objects in production can be edited in place. Every code-integrity assumption in the landscape depends on this flag staying closed.
sample_log:
2026-10-28T11:35:12Z host=sapprd01 sid=PRD client=100 user=BASIS_OP1 msgid=AU3 class=Transaction sev=Severe tcode=SE06 msg="Transaction SE06 started"
2026-10-28T11:36:40Z tabname=TADIR_SETTINGS key=GLOBAL field=EDTFLAG value_old=N value_new=X user=BASIS_OP1 tcode=SE06 msg="Global setting changed to Modifiable"
detection: tcode in (SE06,SE03) in production, or TCESYST / global-setting change to modifiable.
attack: T1484 Domain or Tenant Policy Modification

name: Profile parameter changed to weaken security (RZ10 / RZ11)
description: Parameters such as login/min_password_lng, login/no_automatic_user_sapstar, auth/no_check_in_some_cases and rfc/reject_expired_passwd each remove a specific control. Dynamic changes via RZ11 take effect without a restart and are easy to miss.
sample_log: 2026-10-28T11:50:26Z host=sapprd01 sid=PRD user=BASIS_OP1 tcode=RZ11 param=login/no_automatic_user_sapstar value_old=1 value_new=0 scope=dynamic msg="Profile parameter changed dynamically"
detection: Baseline a parameter allow-list; alert on any change to the security-relevant set, in either direction.

name: High-risk ICF service activated (SICF)
description: Services such as /sap/bc/soap/rfc, /sap/bc/webdynpro, /sap/bc/gui/sap/its/webgui and /sap/public/* expose SAP function over HTTP. Activating one, especially on an internet-facing system, creates a new remote attack surface.
log_sources: SAP ICM / Web Dispatcher Access Log
sample_log:
2026-10-28T12:04:18Z host=sapprd01 sid=PRD client=100 user=BASIS_OP1 msgid=AU3 class=Transaction sev=Severe tcode=SICF msg="Transaction SICF started"
2026-10-28T12:05:02Z sid=PRD node=/default_host/sap/bc/soap/rfc action=ACTIVATE user=BASIS_OP1 auth=BASIC anon_user=none
detection: tcode=SICF plus activation events on the high-risk service list; cross-check for a matching Web Dispatcher / reverse-proxy rule.

name: Debugging with variable replacement in production (debug-and-replace)
description: S_DEVELOP with ACTVT 02 lets a user stop a program and overwrite field contents in memory, defeating any in-code authorization or approval check. There is no legitimate use for this in a productive financial system.
sample_log:
2026-10-28T12:30:41Z host=sapprd01 sid=PRD client=100 user=C.WEBER msgid=AU3 class=Transaction sev=Severe tcode=/H prog=SAPMF02K msg="Transaction /H (debugging) started"
2026-10-28T12:31:16Z host=sapprd01 sid=PRD client=100 user=C.WEBER msgid=AUO class=Other sev=Critical prog=SAPLFK01 msg="Field contents changed in debugger (variable LFBK-BANKN)"
detection: Debug events (/H, debug-change audit class) in production, especially with a financial program in the call stack.

name: ABAP source code changed directly in a production system
description: A code change in production with no transport behind it is either an undocumented fix or an implant. SE38/SE80/SE24 edit events plus a TRDIR timestamp with no CTS request is the detection.
log_sources: SAP Transport / CTS Logs (STMS, tp, ALOG / SLOG)
sample_log:
2026-10-28T12:48:09Z host=sapprd01 sid=PRD client=100 user=C.WEBER msgid=AU3 class=Transaction sev=Severe tcode=SE38 msg="Transaction SE38 started"
2026-10-28T12:52:31Z sid=PRD object=PROG objname=Z_FI_PAYMENT_CHECK action=SAVE user=C.WEBER transport=none devclass=ZFI msg="Source code modified and activated without transport request"
detection: Repository object change in production where the originating transport is empty or locally created.

name: Dynamically generated ABAP code (INSERT REPORT / GENERATE SUBROUTINE POOL)
description: Code that writes and runs code at runtime evades static review and transport control entirely. It is the ABAP analogue of an eval() backdoor.
sample_log: 2026-10-28T13:05:54Z host=sapprd01 sid=PRD client=100 user=RFC_MIDDLEWARE prog=Z_UTIL_RUNNER stmt="GENERATE SUBROUTINE POOL" generated_prog=%_T0A11B msg="Dynamic program generated and called at runtime"
detection: Audit for GENERATE SUBROUTINE POOL / INSERT REPORT / dynamic program names (%_T*) in productive execution.

name: Native SQL or CALL 'SYSTEM' in custom ABAP code
description: EXEC SQL bypasses the ABAP database interface and its client separation; CALL 'SYSTEM' spawns an OS process. Either in a Z-program is both a control gap and a likely injection point.
sample_log: 2026-10-28T13:18:22Z host=sapprd01 sid=PRD client=100 user=C.WEBER prog=Z_DB_DIRECT stmt="EXEC SQL: UPDATE SAPPRD.USR02 SET BCODE = ? WHERE BNAME = 'DDIC'" rc=0
detection: Static scan (ATC / CVA) findings for EXEC SQL and CALL 'SYSTEM' in Y/Z objects, joined to runtime execution of those programs.

name: User exit, implicit enhancement or BAdI implementation activated in production
description: Enhancement points let code be injected into standard SAP processing without modifying SAP objects. Activating one in production changes business logic in a place reviewers rarely look.
log_sources: SAP Transport / CTS Logs (STMS, tp, ALOG / SLOG)
sample_log: 2026-10-28T13:34:47Z sid=PRD client=100 user=C.WEBER object=ENHO objname=Z_ENH_MIRO_BYPASS enhancement_spot=ES_SAPLMR1M action=ACTIVATE transport=PRDK900412
detection: Repository changes where object type in (ENHO,ENHS,SMOD,CMOD) in a productive system.

name: Trusted RFC relationship abused to hop into production
description: A trusted RFC connection lets a user in the calling system log on to the target without a password. If a low-assurance system (dev, sandbox, solution manager) is trusted by production, compromising the weak system is equivalent to compromising production.
sample_log: 2026-10-28T14:02:11Z host=sapprd01 sid=PRD client=100 user=C.WEBER msgid=AU5 class=RFC Logon sev=Non-Critical term=10.60.3.21 trusted_system=DEV trusted_client=100 calling_user=C.WEBER msg="RFC/CPIC logon successful (type=T, client=100, user=C.WEBER) via trusted system DEV"
detection: msgid=AU5 with trusted logon type; alert when the calling system is of lower classification than the target.

name: Call of a dangerous remote-enabled function module
description: RFC_ABAP_INSTALL_AND_RUN compiles and runs arbitrary ABAP; RFC_START_PROGRAM and SXPG_COMMAND_EXECUTE run OS programs; RFC_READ_TABLE reads any table. A successful call of any of them from outside is effectively remote code execution or bulk data access.
sample_log: 2026-10-28T14:15:38Z host=sapprd01 sid=PRD client=100 user=RFC_MIDDLEWARE msgid=AUK class=RFC Call sev=Critical term=203.0.113.45 fugr=SRFC fm=RFC_ABAP_INSTALL_AND_RUN msg="Successful RFC call RFC_ABAP_INSTALL_AND_RUN (function group = SRFC)"
detection: msgid=AUK AND fm IN (RFC_ABAP_INSTALL_AND_RUN, RFC_START_PROGRAM, SXPG_COMMAND_EXECUTE, RFC_READ_TABLE, /SDF/GEN_RFC_READ_TABLE, DB_EXECUTE_SQL, TH_GREP).

name: Mass table extraction via RFC_READ_TABLE
description: RFC_READ_TABLE is the standard way external tools read SAP tables, and the standard way data is bulk-exfiltrated. Volume and the tables requested separate a reporting integration from a harvest.
sample_log: 2026-10-28T14:28:02Z host=sapprd01 sid=PRD client=100 user=BI_EXTRACT msgid=AUK class=RFC Call sev=Critical term=10.22.8.90 fugr=SDTX fm=RFC_READ_TABLE query_table=LFBK rowcount=18442 msg="Successful RFC call RFC_READ_TABLE (function group = SDTX)"
detection: msgid=AUK AND fm=RFC_READ_TABLE: >= 50 calls in 10 min from one user, or any call where query_table is in the sensitive-table list (USR02, LFBK, KNBK, PA0009, REGUH).

name: Failed RFC authorization check (interface privilege probing)
description: AUL records an RFC call rejected for missing S_RFC authorization. A run of them maps which function groups an interface account can reach, which is reconnaissance against the integration layer.
sample_log: 2026-10-28T14:35:19Z host=sapprd01 sid=PRD client=100 user=RFC_PARTNER msgid=AUL class=RFC Call sev=Critical term=203.0.113.45 fugr=SYST fm=RFC_START_PROGRAM msg="Failed RFC call RFC_START_PROGRAM (function group = SYST) - no authorization"
detection: msgid=AUL: >= 10 distinct function groups denied for one user in 15 min.

name: Gateway registration of an external program denied or newly allowed
description: reg_info controls which external programs may register with the SAP gateway. A denial is an attempt to register a rogue RFC server; a sudden success for an unknown TP name means the ACL was relaxed.
sample_log:
[Thr 140245881] Wed Oct 28 14:44:12 2026
[Thr 140245881] *** ERROR => Registration of tp RFCEXEC from host 203.0.113.45 not allowed (reg_info) [gwxxrd.c 2317]
[Thr 140245881] *** ERROR => GwIRegisterTP: registration of program RFCEXEC denied, client 203.0.113.45:33114
detection: Gateway log lines matching 'reg_info' / 'registration ... not allowed', plus any successful registration of a TP not in the approved list.

name: Gateway used as a proxy to reach another system (prxy_info)
description: The SAP gateway can forward RFC traffic between hosts. Without prxy_info restrictions it becomes a pivot point from a DMZ system into the internal landscape.
sample_log:
[Thr 140245881] Wed Oct 28 14:51:33 2026
[Thr 140245881] *** ERROR => Proxy request from host 203.0.113.45 to sapprd03:3300 denied (prxy_info) [gwxxrd.c 4188]
detection: Gateway proxy denials, and any allowed proxy hop whose source is not an approved integration host.

name: RFC callback rejected or newly permitted
description: In an RFC callback the called system calls back into the caller, running code there under the caller's session. SAP added callback whitelisting (rfc/callback_security_method) precisely because this is an escalation path between systems.
sample_log: 2026-10-28T14:58:07Z host=sapprd01 sid=PRD user=RFC_MIDDLEWARE msg="RFC callback rejected: called FM=Z_REMOTE_SYNC, callback FM=RFC_ABAP_INSTALL_AND_RUN, dest=DEVCLNT100, method=3 (reject and log)"
detection: Callback rejection/simulation entries in SM21 and the gateway log; alert on any callback whose target FM is on the dangerous-FM list.

name: RFC destination created or changed to point at an untrusted host (SM59)
description: An RFC destination stores a target host and often a stored credential. Repointing one, or creating a new one aimed outside the landscape, turns SAP into an outbound channel with saved credentials attached.
sample_log:
2026-10-28T15:06:44Z host=sapprd01 sid=PRD client=100 user=BASIS_OP1 msgid=AU3 class=Transaction sev=Severe tcode=SM59 msg="Transaction SM59 started"
2026-10-28T15:08:12Z tabname=RFCDES key=ZEXFIL_DEST field=RFCOPTIONS value_old= value_new="H=203.0.113.45,S=4433,U=RFC_MIDDLEWARE,P=***" user=BASIS_OP1 tcode=SM59 chngind=I
detection: DBTABLOG on RFCDES / RFCATTRIB; alert when the target host is not an internal landscape host, or when a stored password is added.

name: SAProuter route request denied to an internal service
description: saprouter fronts the landscape for SAP support and partner access. Denied routes to internal dispatcher or gateway ports show someone mapping the landscape through the router.
sample_log:
Wed Oct 28 15:14:02 2026
CONNECT FROM host 203.0.113.45 port 51224 TO host sapprd01 service sapdp00 DENIED by saprouttab entry 4
Wed Oct 28 15:14:04 2026
CONNECT FROM host 203.0.113.45 port 51229 TO host sapprd01 service sapgw00 DENIED by saprouttab entry 4
detection: Repeated DENIED route entries from a single source, or any permitted route not present in the reviewed saprouttab baseline.

name: Message server external monitoring or administration request
description: The message server's external port (ms/server_port_*) should not accept administration. Requests against it are attempts to enumerate the instance list or manipulate logon groups.
sample_log:
[Thr 140] Wed Oct 28 15:21:40 2026
[Thr 140] *** ERROR => MsSExtAdmin: external administration request from 203.0.113.45 rejected (ms/admin_port not enabled) [msxxserv.c 9912]
detection: Message server log entries for external admin/monitor requests; confirm ms/monitor and ms/admin_port are closed.

name: SOAP / HTTP RFC endpoint accessed from an untrusted network
description: /sap/bc/soap/rfc exposes RFC over HTTP with basic authentication. Access to it from outside the integration tier, or with a scripted user agent, is a remote function-call attempt against the application server.
log_sources: SAP ICM / Web Dispatcher Access Log
sample_log:
203.0.113.45 - RFC_MIDDLEWARE [28/Oct/2026:15:30:02 +0000] "POST /sap/bc/soap/rfc?sap-client=100 HTTP/1.1" 200 4812 "-" "python-requests/2.31.0"
203.0.113.45 - RFC_MIDDLEWARE [28/Oct/2026:15:30:03 +0000] "POST /sap/bc/soap/rfc?sap-client=100 HTTP/1.1" 200 183244 "-" "python-requests/2.31.0"
detection: ICM access log where path matches /sap/bc/soap/rfc or /sap/bc/srt/* AND source is outside the approved integration subnets, or user agent is a scripting library.

name: UCON blocklist violation: RFC function called outside its approved profile
description: Unified Connectivity records which remote-enabled function modules are actually used, then blocks the rest. A UCON violation means a function module outside the agreed interface surface was invoked.
sample_log: 2026-10-28T15:41:18Z sid=PRD client=100 user=RFC_PARTNER fm=BAPI_USER_CREATE1 phase=active ucon_status=BLOCKED caller_host=203.0.113.45 msg="RFC call blocked by UCON default blocklist"
detection: UCON blocked/would-be-blocked entries, grouped by calling user and function module.

name: Transport imported into production outside the approved change window
description: Imports are the sanctioned way code and configuration reach production, so an import at an unapproved time is the sanctioned path being misused. The CTS logs carry the request, importer and return code.
log_sources: SAP Transport / CTS Logs (STMS, tp, ALOG / SLOG)
sample_log: 2026-10-28T02:44:19Z sid=PRD action=IMPORT request=DEVK900871 client=100 user=TMSADM rc=0 tp_step=A log=/usr/sap/trans/log/ULOG26_4 msg="Import of request DEVK900871 (Workbench) ended with return code 0"
detection: CTS import events whose timestamp falls outside the change calendar, or whose request has no approved change record.

name: Transport imported directly into production, skipping QA
description: A request that appears in the production import log without a prior successful import in the quality system has bypassed testing and approval. Comparing per-system import history detects it reliably.
log_sources: SAP Transport / CTS Logs (STMS, tp, ALOG / SLOG)
sample_log: 2026-10-28T03:02:51Z sid=PRD action=IMPORT request=DEVK900899 client=100 user=BASIS_OP1 rc=4 prior_import_QAS=none mode=unconditional_mode=1 msg="Import of request DEVK900899 with unconditional mode 1"
detection: Request present in PRD import log with no corresponding QAS import, or imported with unconditional modes (U1/U2) set.

name: Transport containing users, roles or security tables
description: Transports can carry role definitions, profiles, authorization objects and table contents. A security-object transport is a code-reviewed path to privilege change and deserves separate scrutiny from functional changes.
log_sources: SAP Transport / CTS Logs (STMS, tp, ALOG / SLOG)
sample_log: 2026-10-28T03:15:07Z sid=PRD action=IMPORT request=DEVK900901 client=100 user=TMSADM rc=0 objects="ACGR Z_FI_SUPER; SUSO S_DEVELOP; TABU USR02; TABU T000" msg="Import completed"
detection: Parse transport object lists for types ACGR (roles), SUSO (auth objects), PROF, and TABU entries on security tables.

name: tp or R3trans executed directly at operating system level
description: Running tp or R3trans by hand on the host bypasses STMS, its approvals and its queue. It is the standard way to put an object into production with no transport trail inside SAP.
log_sources: OS / Host Logs (syslog, auditd, Windows Event Log)
SAP Transport / CTS Logs (STMS, tp, ALOG / SLOG)
sample_log: Oct 28 03:28:44 sapprd01 audispd: type=EXECVE msg=audit(1793..): argc=5 a0="R3trans" a1="-i" a2="/tmp/.r3t_payload" a3="-w" a4="/tmp/.r3t.log" uid=1001 auid=5012 user=prdadm
detection: Host auditd/EXECVE for tp or R3trans invoked interactively (auid maps to a human, not the scheduler), and imports with no STMS queue entry.

name: Transport request released by its own author (no four-eyes)
description: Release and import should involve more than one person. Where the creator, releaser and importer are the same identity, the entire change control is a single point of trust.
log_sources: SAP Transport / CTS Logs (STMS, tp, ALOG / SLOG)
sample_log:
2026-10-28T03:40:12Z sid=DEV request=DEVK900912 as4user=C.WEBER action=RELEASE released_by=C.WEBER
2026-10-28T03:52:30Z sid=PRD request=DEVK900912 action=IMPORT user=C.WEBER rc=0
detection: E070.AS4USER (author) = releaser = importer for the same request.

name: Mass download of SAP data to a local file
description: Security Audit Log message AUY records the byte count and target file for a list download. Large or repeated downloads from financial, HR or master-data transactions are the most common insider exfiltration pattern in SAP.
sample_log: 2026-10-28T16:02:44Z host=sapprd01 sid=PRD client=100 user=K.VOGEL msgid=AUY class=Other sev=Severe tcode=SE16N prog=RK_SE16N msg="Download 48338112 bytes to file C:\Users\kvogel\Desktop\lfbk_full.xlsx"
detection: msgid=AUY: single download > 10 MB, or sum per user per day above a per-role baseline; weight by source transaction.

name: Large table read through SE16 / SE16N / SM30
description: The generic table browsers read any table the user is authorized for, with no business context. A full read of a master-data or credential-bearing table is data staging regardless of intent.
sample_log:
2026-10-28T16:10:21Z host=sapprd01 sid=PRD client=100 user=K.VOGEL msgid=AU3 class=Transaction sev=Severe tcode=SE16N msg="Transaction SE16N started"
2026-10-28T16:11:08Z sid=PRD client=100 user=K.VOGEL tcode=SE16N table=KNBK rows_selected=24118 maxrows=0 export=XLSX msg="Generic table display executed"
detection: Table-browser executions where rows selected exceeds a threshold, or the table is on the sensitive list; always alert when combined with AUY.

name: Read Access Logging spike on sensitive HR or PII fields
description: RAL is the only SAP mechanism that records reads of specific fields. A sudden spike in a logged domain (salary, bank details, national IDs) by one user is a privacy incident whether or not data left the system.
sample_log: 2026-10-28T16:22:40Z sid=PRD client=100 user=HR_SUPPORT1 channel=DYNP tcode=PA20 log_domain=HR_SENSITIVE fields="PERNR,GBDAT,SSN,BANKN" access_count=487 distinct_pernr=463 session=0000123456
detection: RAL access_count or distinct business keys per user per hour above baseline; alert on any access by accounts outside the HR role family.

name: Mass record extraction through an OData / Fiori service
description: Fiori and third-party apps read SAP through OData. A single GET with $top removed, or a paged loop pulling an entire entity set, is bulk extraction over an interface that looks like ordinary user traffic.
log_sources: SAP ICM / Web Dispatcher Access Log
sample_log: 2026-10-28T16:35:09Z sid=PRD client=100 user=J.DOE service=ZHR_EMPLOYEE_SRV operation=GET entity=EmployeeSet query="$select=Pernr,Name,Iban&$top=100000" http=200 records=84211 runtime_ms=61240 source_ip=10.14.22.87
detection: Gateway/OData records where record count or response bytes exceed a per-service baseline, or $top is absent on a large entity set.

name: Sensitive spool request created or accessed by a non-owner
description: Spool requests hold rendered payroll, payment and customer reports. SP01 access to another user's spool, or a mass display/export of spool requests, is a quiet way to read reports without ever running them.
sample_log: 2026-10-28T16:48:33Z sid=PRD client=100 user=J.DOE tcode=SP01 spool_no=0000084412 owner=HR_PAYROLL title="Payroll register 10/2026" action=DISPLAY pages=612 download=PDF
detection: TSP01 access where accessing user != owner, or bulk access to > 10 spool requests in an hour.

name: Payment file (DMEE) generated, downloaded or altered outside the payment run
description: The payment medium file is the instruction the bank acts on. Generating or touching it outside the scheduled run, or downloading it to a workstation, is the final step of a payment fraud.
sample_log: 2026-10-28T17:02:19Z sid=PRD client=100 user=C.WEBER tcode=FDTA prog=RFFOEDI1 action=DOWNLOAD file="\\fileshare\treasury\PAYM_20261028.xml" run_id=F110-20261028-01 items=142 total=EUR 4,318,220.00 scheduled_run=no
detection: DMEE / FDTA / F110 medium access with no corresponding scheduled payment run, or any download of a payment file to a non-server path.

name: Direct table update via SE16N debug-edit (&SAP_EDIT)
description: Entering &SAP_EDIT in SE16N, or using the debugger to set the edit flag, allows direct writes to any table with no application logic, no change document and no validation. It is the clearest sign of deliberate data manipulation.
sample_log:
2026-10-28T17:18:47Z host=sapprd01 sid=PRD client=100 user=C.WEBER msgid=AU3 class=Transaction sev=Severe tcode=SE16N msg="Transaction SE16N started"
2026-10-28T17:19:52Z sid=PRD client=100 user=C.WEBER tcode=SE16N cmd=&SAP_EDIT table=REGUH action=UPDATE key=100/2026/F110/0000142 field=ZBNKN value_old=1234567890 value_new=7788990011
detection: SE16N with SAP_EDIT / UASE16N_START_VALUE, or DBTABLOG updates whose transaction code is a table browser rather than a business transaction.

name: Change to a critical configuration or authorization table
description: Tables such as T000 (clients), USR02 (logon data), TOBJ (auth objects), TACT/TACTZ (activities) and PRGN_CUST (security settings) underpin the control framework. Direct changes to them are control changes, not data changes.
sample_log: 2026-10-28T17:31:04Z tabname=PRGN_CUST key=REF_USER_CHECK field=VALUE value_old=E value_new= user=SEC_ADMIN tcode=SM30 chngind=U sid=PRD client=100
detection: DBTABLOG on the critical-table list; requires rec/client and table logging to be switched on.

name: Vendor bank account changed (LFBK)
description: Redirecting a vendor's bank details and waiting for the next payment run is the highest-value SAP fraud, and it leaves a clean change document. Correlating the change with a subsequent payment to the same vendor closes the case.
sample_log: 2026-10-28T17:44:12Z objectclass=KRED objectid=0000104500 changenr=0000234567 username=C.WEBER udate=2026-10-28 utime=17:44:12 tcode=FK02 tabname=LFBK fname=BANKN value_old=1234567890 value_new=7788990011 chngind=U
detection: CDPOS on LFBK (BANKN, BANKL, IBAN); escalate when a payment to the same LIFNR follows within 14 days, or when the changer also releases payments.

name: Customer bank details or payment terms changed
description: Changes to KNBK (bank data) and KNB1 payment terms shift money and credit exposure. Like vendor changes they are legitimate routinely, so the signal is who changed it and what followed.
sample_log: 2026-10-28T17:52:30Z objectclass=DEBI objectid=0000500871 changenr=0000234612 username=SD_SUPPORT udate=2026-10-28 utime=17:52:30 tcode=XD02 tabname=KNB1 fname=ZTERM value_old=NT30 value_new=NT180 chngind=U
detection: CDPOS on KNBK / KNB1 (ZTERM, KLIMK) by users outside the master-data role, or where the same user also posts or clears invoices.

name: Employee bank details or salary changed in HR master data
description: Infotype 0008 (basic pay) and 0009 (bank details) drive payroll. A change to an employee's bank account shortly before a payroll run, especially by someone other than the HR owner, is payroll diversion.
sample_log: 2026-10-28T18:04:55Z objectclass=PERSONAL objectid=00847122 changenr=0000234699 username=HR_SUPPORT1 udate=2026-10-28 utime=18:04:55 tcode=PA30 infotype=0009 tabname=PA0009 fname=BANKN value_old=5566778899 value_new=7788990011 chngind=U
detection: PA0009/PA0008 changes within N days of a payroll run, or made by a user who is not the employee's assigned HR administrator.

name: Posting period reopened or document posted to a closed period
description: Reopening periods in OB52 lets results be restated after close. The change and the postings that follow it belong in the same alert.
sample_log: 2026-10-28T18:20:11Z tabname=T001B key=1000/+/0001 field=FRPE1 value_old=010 value_new=009 user=FI_CLOSE01 tcode=OB52 chngind=U sid=PRD client=100
detection: T001B changes via OB52; then watch for BKPF postings with BUDAT in the reopened period by the same or a related user.

name: Security Audit Log configuration changed or deactivated
description: The audit log is the evidence base for almost every other use case here. Message AUE records changes to its own configuration, so an attacker turning filters off still writes one last record before the lights go out.
sample_log: 2026-10-28T18:40:02Z host=sapprd01 sid=PRD client=100 user=BASIS_OP1 msgid=AUE class=System sev=Critical tcode=RSAU_CONFIG msg="Audit configuration changed: static profile SEC_PROD deactivated"
detection: Alert on every msgid=AUE and on tcode in (RSAU_CONFIG, SM19). Also alert when the audit event rate for a system drops to zero.

name: Audit log event volume drops to zero for a system (log starvation)
description: If the audit log is disabled at the profile level, or the forwarder breaks, the absence of events is the only signal left. A heartbeat detection catches both an attacker and a broken pipeline.
sample_log:
# no events received from source
sid=PRD host=sapprd01 last_event=2026-10-28T18:40:02Z expected_rate=~2400/h observed_rate=0/h window=60m status=SOURCE_SILENT
detection: Per-source event-rate floor: alert when hourly count falls below a fraction of the 7-day baseline, or no event in 30 min for an active production system.
attack: T1562.008 Disable or Modify Cloud Logs

name: Audit log files deleted or truncated at operating system level
description: The audit log is written to flat files under /usr/sap/<SID>/<inst>/log. Deleting or truncating them on the host destroys evidence without producing any SAP event at all, which is why host-level file auditing matters.
log_sources: OS / Host Logs (syslog, auditd, Windows Event Log)
sample_log:
Oct 28 18:52:17 sapprd01 audispd: type=PATH msg=audit(1793..): item=0 name="/usr/sap/PRD/D00/log/audit_20261028" nametype=DELETE
Oct 28 18:52:17 sapprd01 audispd: type=SYSCALL msg=audit(1793..): syscall=unlink exe="/usr/bin/rm" auid=5012 uid=1001 comm="rm" success=yes
detection: auditd/FIM watch on the SAP log and work directories for unlink/truncate/rename by any identity other than the archiving job.

name: Table change logging switched off (rec/client)
description: rec/client decides whether DBTABLOG records table changes at all. Setting it to OFF, even briefly, creates a window in which direct table manipulation leaves no trace.
sample_log: 2026-10-28T19:01:44Z host=sapprd01 sid=PRD user=BASIS_OP1 tcode=RZ11 param=rec/client value_old=ALL value_new=OFF scope=dynamic msg="Profile parameter changed dynamically"
detection: Any change to rec/client, or to the log-data-changes flag on a technical settings record (SE13) for a logged table.

name: Change documents or table change logs deleted
description: Change documents (CDHDR/CDPOS) and DBTABLOG are purged by housekeeping reports. An unscheduled run of those reports, or a direct delete, removes the record of exactly the changes an investigation would look for.
sample_log:
2026-10-28T19:12:08Z host=sapprd01 sid=PRD client=100 user=C.WEBER msgid=AUW class=Transaction sev=Severe prog=RSCDOK99 msg="Report RSCDOK99 started"   # change document reorganisation, unscheduled
2026-10-28T19:13:51Z sid=PRD client=100 user=C.WEBER prog=RSCDOK99 action=DELETE objectclass=KRED date_to=2026-10-28 records_deleted=18442
detection: Execution of RSCDOK99 / RSTBPDEL / RSAU_* delete reports outside the housekeeping schedule, or by a non-basis account.

name: System log (SM21) cleared or its retention shortened
description: SM21 holds kernel and dispatcher events including dumps, failed logons at low level and instance restarts. Shortening its retention or wiping it hides infrastructure-level traces.
log_sources: OS / Host Logs (syslog, auditd, Windows Event Log)
sample_log: Oct 28 19:22:40 sapprd01 audispd: type=SYSCALL msg=audit(1793..): syscall=truncate exe="/usr/bin/truncate" name="/usr/sap/PRD/D00/log/SLOG26" auid=5012 comm="truncate" success=yes
detection: FIM on SLOG* files, plus changes to rslg/max_diskspace/local and rslg/collect_daemon parameters.

name: UCON or gateway security logging disabled
description: gw/logging, gw/reg_no_conn_info and the UCON phase settings control whether interface misuse is recorded or blocked. Relaxing them is preparation for RFC abuse rather than an operational tuning step.
sample_log: 2026-10-28T19:31:16Z host=sapprd01 sid=PRD user=BASIS_OP1 tcode=RZ11 param=gw/reg_no_conn_info value_old=255 value_new=0 scope=dynamic msg="Gateway security relaxed: registration ACL checks reduced"
detection: Changes to gw/* security parameters, gw/logging, or a UCON phase moved from active back to logging/evaluation.

name: Logon as the HANA SYSTEM user
description: SYSTEM is the HANA superuser and SAP's own guidance is to deactivate it after installation. Any authentication as SYSTEM in production is either an unmanaged break-glass action or a full database compromise.
sample_log: 2026-10-28T19:44:02.118Z host=saphana01 service=indexserver conn_id=401234 client_ip=203.0.113.45 user=SYSTEM app_user= policy=AUDIT_LOGON event_action=CONNECT event_status=SUCCESSFUL db=HDB msg="Successful connection as SYSTEM"
detection: HANA audit trail CONNECT events where user=SYSTEM, or any SUCCESSFUL authentication by a user flagged as deactivated.

name: Grant of a powerful HANA system privilege
description: DATA ADMIN, USER ADMIN, ROLE ADMIN, CATALOG READ, BACKUP ADMIN and TRUST ADMIN each confer control over the database or its security. Grants of them should be rare, named and ticketed.
sample_log: 2026-10-28T19:51:33.402Z host=saphana01 service=indexserver user=SYSTEM app_user=BASIS_OP1 client_ip=10.14.9.33 policy=SEC_PRIV_CHANGE event_action=GRANT PRIVILEGE event_status=SUCCESSFUL privilege="DATA ADMIN" grantee=J_DOE grantor=SYSTEM stmt="GRANT DATA ADMIN TO J_DOE"
detection: event_action in (GRANT PRIVILEGE, GRANT ROLE) where privilege/role is on the powerful list, or grantee is a personal (non-service) account.

name: Failed HANA authentication burst
description: HANA is often reachable on 3xx15 from more of the network than it should be. A burst of failed connects, particularly for SYSTEM or SAP<SID>, is direct database password guessing.
sample_log:
2026-10-28T19:58:11.904Z host=saphana01 service=indexserver client_ip=203.0.113.45 user=SAPPRD policy=AUDIT_LOGON event_action=CONNECT event_status=UNSUCCESSFUL db=HDB msg="authentication failed"
2026-10-28T19:58:12.311Z host=saphana01 service=indexserver client_ip=203.0.113.45 user=SYSTEM policy=AUDIT_LOGON event_action=CONNECT event_status=UNSUCCESSFUL db=HDB msg="authentication failed"
detection: event_status=UNSUCCESSFUL CONNECT: >= 10 in 5 min per client_ip, or >= 5 distinct users per client_ip.

name: Direct access to the SAP schema bypassing the application layer
description: All ABAP business data lives in the SAP<SID> schema. A query against it by anything other than the ABAP connection user means the entire application authorization layer has been side-stepped.
sample_log: 2026-10-28T20:06:44.233Z host=saphana01 service=indexserver user=J_DOE app_user=J.DOE client_ip=10.14.22.87 policy=SEC_SENSITIVE_READ event_action=SELECT event_status=SUCCESSFUL schema=SAPPRD object=LFBK stmt="SELECT LIFNR, BANKL, BANKN FROM SAPPRD.LFBK" rows=18442
detection: Audit policy on the SAP<SID> schema for SELECT by any user other than the ABAP connect user; alert on row counts above a threshold.

name: HANA audit policy disabled, dropped or altered
description: The audit policy set is the HANA equivalent of the Security Audit Log configuration. Disabling global auditing or dropping a policy removes database-level visibility entirely.
sample_log: 2026-10-28T20:14:29.118Z host=saphana01 service=indexserver user=SYSTEM app_user=BASIS_OP1 client_ip=10.14.9.33 policy=SEC_CONFIG_CHANGE event_action=ALTER SYSTEM event_status=SUCCESSFUL stmt="ALTER SYSTEM ALTER CONFIGURATION ('global.ini','SYSTEM') SET ('auditing configuration','global_auditing_state') = 'false'"
detection: Statements matching global_auditing_state, DROP AUDIT POLICY, or ALTER AUDIT POLICY ... DISABLE.
attack: T1562.008 Disable or Modify Cloud Logs

name: HANA backup deleted or backup catalog modified
description: Destroying backups is the step that turns an intrusion into an extortion event. The backup catalog records both the deletion and who issued it.
log_sources: SAP HANA Backup Catalog / indexserver Trace
sample_log: 2026-10-28T20:22:51.660Z host=saphana01 service=indexserver user=BACKUP_OP app_user=J.DOE policy=SEC_BACKUP event_action=BACKUP CATALOG DELETE event_status=SUCCESSFUL stmt="BACKUP CATALOG DELETE ALL BEFORE BACKUP_ID 1793000000000 COMPLETE" backups_removed=42
detection: BACKUP CATALOG DELETE / BACKUP DELETE statements, and backup file removal at the filesystem level outside the retention job.

name: SQL injection pattern in a HANA statement
description: Where custom XSA, ABAP native SQL or a reporting layer concatenates input into SQL, the injected payload appears in the audited statement string. Pattern-matching the statement text catches attempts that the application never noticed.
sample_log: 2026-10-28T20:31:07.441Z host=saphana01 service=xsengine user=XSA_APP app_user=anonymous client_ip=203.0.113.45 policy=SEC_SENSITIVE_READ event_action=SELECT event_status=SUCCESSFUL stmt="SELECT * FROM SAPPRD.KNA1 WHERE KUNNR = '1' OR '1'='1' UNION ALL SELECT USER_NAME, PASSWORD_CHANGE_TIME FROM SYS.USERS--'"
detection: Statement strings matching UNION ALL SELECT, OR '1'='1', ';--', or references to SYS.USERS / SYS.CREDENTIALS from an application user.

name: HANA user created or granted a role outside provisioning
description: Database users created locally in HANA sit outside the SAP identity process and outside most access reviews, which makes them durable persistence.
sample_log: 2026-10-28T20:38:19.027Z host=saphana01 service=indexserver user=SYSTEM app_user=BASIS_OP1 policy=SEC_USER_ADMIN event_action=CREATE USER event_status=SUCCESSFUL stmt="CREATE USER SVC_REPORT PASSWORD *** NO FORCE_FIRST_PASSWORD_CHANGE" grantee=SVC_REPORT
detection: event_action in (CREATE USER, ALTER USER, GRANT ROLE) with no matching provisioning record; flag NO FORCE_FIRST_PASSWORD_CHANGE and non-expiring passwords.

name: BTP subaccount or global account administrator role granted
description: Subaccount Administrator in BTP is equivalent to owning everything deployed in that subaccount, including destinations and their stored credentials. The audit log service records the assignment with actor and target.
sample_log: {"time":"2026-10-28T20:50:11.233Z","category":"audit.security-events","format_version":"2.0","tenant":"a1b2c3d4-prd","user":"j.doe@corp.com","ip":"203.0.113.45","message":{"type":"role-collection-assignment","role_collection":"Subaccount Administrator","target_user":"svc_integration@corp.com","result":"success"}}
detection: BTP audit records of type role-collection-assignment where the role collection is administrative, or the target is a technical user.

name: BTP destination created or its credentials changed
description: Destinations hold the URLs and credentials BTP applications use to reach on-premise SAP and third parties. Changing one redirects a trusted integration; reading one yields a credential.
sample_log: {"time":"2026-10-28T20:57:44.108Z","category":"audit.configuration-change","tenant":"a1b2c3d4-prd","user":"svc_integration@corp.com","ip":"10.44.2.19","message":{"type":"destination","name":"PRD_ERP_RFC","action":"update","attributes":[{"name":"URL","old":"https://erp.corp.internal","new":"https://collector.203-0-113-45.sslip.io"},{"name":"Password","old":"***","new":"***"}]}}
detection: audit.configuration-change on destinations; alert when the URL host leaves the approved domain list or a credential attribute changes.

name: Long-lived BTP service key or client secret created
description: Service keys and X.509/secret bindings are bearer credentials that often outlive the person who made them. Creation events are the only point at which they can be governed.
sample_log: {"time":"2026-10-28T21:04:02.771Z","category":"audit.security-events","tenant":"a1b2c3d4-prd","user":"j.doe@corp.com","message":{"type":"service-binding-key","service":"xsuaa","instance":"prd-uaa","action":"create","key_name":"ci-pipeline-key","expires":"never"}}
detection: Service key / binding creation where expiry is unset, or the creating identity is not a platform-operations account.

name: Failed authentication burst against SAP Cloud Identity (IAS)
description: IAS fronts Fiori, SuccessFactors and BTP logons. Password spraying there is cheap, internet-facing and the usual first step toward an SAP cloud account takeover.
log_sources: SAP Cloud Identity Services (IAS) Audit Log
sample_log: {"time":"2026-10-28T21:11:19.500Z","eventType":"UserAuthenticationFailed","tenant":"corp-ias","userId":"j.doe@corp.com","applicationName":"S4HANA Fiori PRD","sourceIp":"203.0.113.45","userAgent":"Mozilla/5.0","reason":"INVALID_CREDENTIALS"}
detection: UserAuthenticationFailed: >= 10 per sourceIp in 5 min, or >= 5 distinct userIds per sourceIp; alert on any success that follows.

name: Multi-factor authentication disabled or reset for an IAS user
description: Turning MFA off, or resetting a user's second factor and re-enrolling it, is the standard way an attacker makes stolen credentials usable and keeps them usable.
log_sources: SAP Cloud Identity Services (IAS) Audit Log
sample_log: {"time":"2026-10-28T21:18:33.212Z","eventType":"UserMfaConfigurationChanged","tenant":"corp-ias","adminUser":"admin@corp.com","targetUser":"cfo@corp.com","change":{"attribute":"totp","old":"ENABLED","new":"DISABLED"},"sourceIp":"203.0.113.45"}
detection: MFA configuration change events; escalate when target is a privileged or executive account, or when a logon by the target follows within an hour.

name: Cloud Integration (CPI) iFlow or credential changed
description: CPI moves business documents between SAP and partners. Changing a deployed iFlow or a stored credential alters or redirects live transaction flows, and the audit log is the only record.
sample_log:
{"time":"2026-10-28T21:25:41.339Z","category":"audit.configuration-change","tenant":"corp-cpi-prd","user":"integration.dev@corp.com","message":{"type":"credential","name":"SF_HCM_BASIC","action":"update"}}
{"time":"2026-10-28T21:26:10.004Z","category":"audit.configuration-change","tenant":"corp-cpi-prd","user":"integration.dev@corp.com","message":{"type":"integration-flow","name":"IF_PAYMENT_TO_BANK","action":"deploy","version":"1.4.0"}}
detection: CPI configuration-change events on credentials, keystores or payment-relevant iFlows outside a change window.

name: Mass employee data export from SuccessFactors
description: SuccessFactors holds the full workforce record. Ad-hoc report exports and OData pulls of the employee entity are the main bulk-PII egress path in SAP HCM cloud.
sample_log: {"time":"2026-10-28T21:33:08.550Z","eventType":"AdHocReportExport","tenant":"corpPRD","user":"hr.analyst@corp.com","reportName":"All Employees - Full Detail","entities":["PerPersonal","PerEmail","PerNationalId","EmpPayCompRecurring"],"recordCount":84211,"format":"CSV","sourceIp":"203.0.113.45"}
detection: Report export or OData calls where recordCount exceeds a per-user baseline, or sensitive entities (NationalId, PayComp, Bank) are included.

name: Supplier bank details changed in Ariba
description: The vendor bank-change fraud has moved upstream into supplier self-service portals. A change made through Ariba that then flows into ERP bypasses the ERP-side approval entirely.
sample_log: {"time":"2026-10-28T21:41:22.900Z","realm":"corp-prd","eventType":"SupplierBankAccountChanged","supplierId":"SUP-104500","supplierName":"Nordwind Logistik GmbH","changedBy":"portal:supplier-admin@nordwind.example","field":"IBAN","old":"DE02120300000000202051","new":"LT121000011101001000","approvalWorkflow":"auto-approved","sourceIp":"203.0.113.45"}
detection: Supplier bank-detail changes, especially auto-approved ones, changes to a different country/IBAN prefix, or changes shortly before an invoice release.

name: Same user created a vendor and released a payment to it (SoD violation)
description: Vendor creation and payment release must sit with different people. Where the audit trail shows one identity on both sides of a payment, the control has failed regardless of whether money moved.
sample_log:
2026-10-28T21:50:04Z objectclass=KRED objectid=0000104999 changenr=0000234810 username=C.WEBER tcode=FK01 action=CREATE name="Helios Trading Ltd"
2026-10-28T21:58:37Z sid=PRD client=100 user=C.WEBER tcode=F110 run_id=F110-20261028-02 action=PAYMENT_RUN_RELEASE lifnr=0000104999 amount=EUR 94,800.00 bank=LT121000011101001000
detection: Join vendor-create change documents (CDHDR objectclass=KRED, tcode FK01/XK01) with F110 / FBZP release events on the same LIFNR by the same user.

name: Payment released to a vendor whose bank details changed recently
description: This is the completion of the bank-change fraud. Neither event alone is unusual; the sequence within a short window is the alert that matters.
sample_log:
2026-10-28T17:44:12Z objectclass=KRED objectid=0000104500 changenr=0000234567 username=C.WEBER tcode=FK02 tabname=LFBK fname=BANKN value_old=1234567890 value_new=7788990011
2026-10-29T02:10:55Z sid=PRD client=100 user=FI_PAYRUN tcode=F110 run_id=F110-20261029-01 lifnr=0000104500 amount=EUR 318,420.00 bank=7788990011 status=PAID
detection: Payment to a LIFNR where a LFBK change exists within the preceding 14 days; rank by amount.

name: Goods receipt and invoice posted by the same user
description: Three-way match depends on receipt and invoice being independent. One identity doing both allows payment for goods never delivered.
sample_log:
2026-10-29T08:14:22Z sid=PRD client=100 user=MM_CLERK1 tcode=MIGO action=GOODS_RECEIPT ebeln=4500018842 mblnr=5000234119 amount=EUR 62,000.00
2026-10-29T08:21:40Z sid=PRD client=100 user=MM_CLERK1 tcode=MIRO action=INVOICE_POST ebeln=4500018842 belnr=5105001882 amount=EUR 62,000.00
detection: Same user on MIGO and MIRO for one purchase order, within the same period.

name: Purchase order created and released by the same user
description: Release strategies exist so that a requisition is approved by someone other than its author. Self-release, or a PO split to stay under a release threshold, defeats it.
sample_log:
2026-10-29T08:35:11Z sid=PRD client=100 user=MM_CLERK1 tcode=ME21N action=PO_CREATE ebeln=4500018850 net_value=EUR 24,900.00 release_group=01
2026-10-29T08:36:02Z sid=PRD client=100 user=MM_CLERK1 tcode=ME29N action=PO_RELEASE ebeln=4500018850 release_code=R1
detection: Same user on ME21N/ME22N and ME28/ME29N for one EBELN; also flag repeated POs just below a release threshold to the same vendor.

name: Journal entry posted outside business hours by a privileged user
description: Manual postings at night, by an account that also holds configuration or basis rights, are the classic financial-statement manipulation pattern that external audit asks about.
sample_log: 2026-10-29T03:12:44Z sid=PRD client=100 user=FI_POWER01 tcode=FB01 belnr=0100087712 bukrs=1000 blart=SA budat=2026-09-30 amount=EUR 1,240,000.00 posting_hour=03 user_has_sap_all=true
detection: BKPF postings where posting time is outside business hours AND user holds critical authorizations, or BUDAT is in a prior period.

name: One-time vendor account reused across multiple payments
description: One-time (CPD) vendor accounts carry bank details on the document rather than the master record, so they escape master-data controls. Repeated use of a CPD account is a deliberate route around them.
sample_log: 2026-10-29T09:02:18Z sid=PRD client=100 user=FI_CLERK2 tcode=FB60 belnr=1900042118 lifnr=CPD00001 name1="Ad-hoc Services" bank=LT121000011101001000 amount=EUR 48,200.00  # 7th use of this IBAN in 30 days
detection: Count distinct documents per CPD account or per document-level IBAN over 30 days; alert above a small threshold.

name: Customer credit limit raised then large order released
description: Raising a credit limit and immediately releasing a blocked order converts a credit control into a loss. Both events are routine alone.
sample_log:
2026-10-29T09:20:33Z objectclass=DEBI objectid=0000500871 changenr=0000234922 username=SD_SUPPORT tcode=FD32 tabname=KNKK fname=KLIMK value_old=50000 value_new=2000000 chngind=U
2026-10-29T09:24:02Z sid=PRD client=100 user=SD_SUPPORT tcode=VKM3 vbeln=0000884412 action=CREDIT_RELEASE net_value=EUR 1,850,000.00
detection: KNKK.KLIMK increase followed by a credit release (VKM3/VKM1) on the same customer by the same user within 24 h.

name: Mass deletion of business or configuration data
description: A high-volume delete against business tables, whether through a Z-program, a table browser or native SQL, is either a serious operational error or destructive action. Rate is the detection, not intent.
sample_log: 2026-10-29T09:40:02Z sid=PRD client=100 user=C.WEBER prog=Z_CLEANUP_UTIL table=BKPF action=DELETE rows_deleted=184422 duration_s=612 commit=implicit
detection: Delete volume per table per hour above baseline; any DELETE on BKPF/BSEG/MSEG/LFA1/KNA1 outside archiving jobs.

name: SAP instance or service stopped outside a maintenance window
description: An unplanned instance stop is either an outage or an attacker clearing sessions, breaking log forwarding or preparing for host-level work. Message AUH records it from the application side.
log_sources: OS / Host Logs (syslog, auditd, Windows Event Log)
sample_log:
2026-10-29T09:52:11Z host=sapprd01 sid=PRD inst=D00 msgid=AUH class=System sev=Severe msg="Application server sapprd01_PRD_00 stopped"
Oct 29 09:52:10 sapprd01 systemd: SAP PRD instance D00: stopping (initiated by uid=1001 prdadm, auid=5012)
detection: msgid in (AUG,AUH) outside the maintenance calendar, correlated with host-level stopsap/systemd events and the invoking human identity.

name: Client copy, client reset or client deletion (SCC5 / SCCL)
description: SCC5 deletes a client; SCCL overwrites one. Executed against production these destroy or overwrite the live dataset, and the transaction is rarely needed outside a project.
sample_log:
2026-10-29T10:02:44Z host=sapprd01 sid=PRD client=100 user=BASIS_OP1 msgid=AU3 class=Transaction sev=Severe tcode=SCC5 msg="Transaction SCC5 started"
2026-10-29T10:04:19Z sid=PRD user=BASIS_OP1 prog=SCC5_DELETE_CLIENT target_client=100 scope="client-specific data + user master" status=STARTED
detection: tcode in (SCC5,SCCL,SCC9,SCC8) on a production SID. Treat as critical regardless of outcome.

name: Ransomware indicators on SAP file systems
description: SAP data, executable and transport directories are high-value ransomware targets. Rapid rename or rewrite activity across /sapmnt, /usr/sap/trans or the HANA data volume is encryption in progress.
log_sources: OS / Host Logs (syslog, auditd, Windows Event Log)
sample_log:
Oct 29 10:14:02 sapprd01 audispd: type=SYSCALL msg=audit(1793..): syscall=rename exe="/tmp/.sysupd" comm=".sysupd" auid=5012 success=yes
Oct 29 10:14:02 sapprd01 audispd: type=PATH name="/usr/sap/trans/data/R900871.DEV" nametype=DELETE
Oct 29 10:14:02 sapprd01 audispd: type=PATH name="/usr/sap/trans/data/R900871.DEV.locked" nametype=CREATE
detection: FIM: high-rate rename/create with new extensions under /sapmnt, /usr/sap, /hana/data; correlate with instance crashes and backup deletions.

name: Secure Network Communication disabled, exposing SAP traffic in clear text
description: With SNC off, DIAG and RFC traffic including credentials crosses the network unencrypted. Turning it off is a prerequisite for credential interception and a regression of a baseline control.
sample_log: 2026-10-29T10:25:41Z host=sapprd01 sid=PRD user=BASIS_OP1 tcode=RZ10 param=snc/enable value_old=1 value_new=0 scope=profile restart_required=yes msg="Profile parameter changed"
detection: Changes to snc/* parameters, or to icm/server_port_* dropping from HTTPS to HTTP.

name: SAP kernel or security patch level downgraded
description: A kernel downgrade restores known vulnerabilities and is occasionally used to re-open an exploited path. Patch level is cheap to baseline and monitor per host.
log_sources: OS / Host Logs (syslog, auditd, Windows Event Log)
sample_log: 2026-10-29T10:36:08Z host=sapprd01 sid=PRD component=kernel value_old="753 patch 1200" value_new="753 patch 900" changed_by=prdadm msg="Instance restarted with downgraded kernel patch level"
detection: Compare reported kernel/patch level per host against the previous value; alert on any decrease.

name: Web Dispatcher or ICM serving an administration or diagnostic path externally
description: Paths such as /sap/admin, /sap/public/icman, /sap/bc/ping and the Web Dispatcher admin handler should never be reachable from an untrusted network. External requests against them are reconnaissance of the web tier.
log_sources: SAP ICM / Web Dispatcher Access Log
detection: ICM/Web Dispatcher access log where path matches the admin/diagnostic list AND source is external; a 200 on /sap/public/info is itself a finding.

name: Fiori launchpad session used from a changing source address
description: A single authenticated SAP session whose requests arrive from two different networks indicates a stolen session cookie or token replay rather than a roaming user.
log_sources: SAP ICM / Web Dispatcher Access Log
sample_log:
2026-10-29T10:55:11Z sid=PRD client=100 user=J.DOE session=SID%3aANON%3asapprd01_PRD_00%3a7f2a source_ip=10.14.22.87 path=/sap/bc/ui2/flp
2026-10-29T10:55:48Z sid=PRD client=100 user=J.DOE session=SID%3aANON%3asapprd01_PRD_00%3a7f2a source_ip=203.0.113.45 path=/sap/opu/odata/sap/ZFI_PAYMENT_SRV/PaymentSet
detection: Same SAP session/security token observed from more than one source IP or ASN inside the session lifetime.

name: PI/PO payment interface channel failure or credential error
description: The integration layer carries payment and banking traffic. Authentication failures or a channel stopped and restarted on a payment interface are both an availability event and a possible tamper attempt.
log_sources: SAP PI / PO Message & Audit Log
sample_log: 2026-10-29T11:04:41Z system=PO_PRD msgid=4f2a8c11-... sender=FI_PAYMENT_OUT receiver=BANK_SFTP_IN channel=CC_PAYMENT_SFTP adapter=SFTP status=ERROR user=PIISUSER severity=ERROR text="Authentication failed for user treasury_prd - host key mismatch for sftp.bank.example"
detection: PI/PO channel errors on payment interfaces, host-key mismatches, and manual channel stop/start outside a change window.

name: Unapproved OS-level logon to an SAP host as <sid>adm or the database user
description: sidadm and the database OS user can read the secure store, edit profiles and delete logs. Interactive logons by them bypass every application-layer control in this library.
log_sources: OS / Host Logs (syslog, auditd, Windows Event Log)
sample_log:
Oct 29 11:14:02 sapprd01 sshd[44120]: Accepted publickey for prdadm from 203.0.113.45 port 51992 ssh2: RSA SHA256:9f2a...
Oct 29 11:14:03 sapprd01 su: pam_unix(su:session): session opened for user prdadm by jdoe(uid=5012)
detection: Interactive sessions for <sid>adm / sapadm / hdbadm, especially via direct SSH rather than su from a named account, and from outside the jump hosts.

name: SAP secure store (SSFS / rsecssfs) files read or copied
description: The secure store holds the database connect credentials and RFC destination passwords. Reading those files is a credential theft with no application-layer footprint at all.
log_sources: OS / Host Logs (syslog, auditd, Windows Event Log)
sample_log:
Oct 29 11:22:18 sapprd01 audispd: type=SYSCALL msg=audit(1793..): syscall=openat exe="/usr/bin/scp" comm="scp" auid=5012 success=yes
Oct 29 11:22:18 sapprd01 audispd: type=PATH name="/sapmnt/PRD/global/security/rsecssfs/data/SSFS_PRD.DAT" nametype=NORMAL
detection: auditd watch on rsecssfs data and key directories for any access by a process other than the SAP kernel binaries.

name: Enumeration of SAP users or authorizations (SUIM / USR tables)
description: Before escalating, an attacker needs to know which accounts hold which roles. SUIM reports and reads of USR02 / AGR_USERS are the SAP form of account and permission discovery.
sample_log:
2026-10-29T11:33:02Z host=sapprd01 sid=PRD client=100 user=J.DOE msgid=AU3 class=Transaction sev=Severe tcode=SUIM msg="Transaction SUIM started"
2026-10-29T11:34:44Z sid=PRD client=100 user=J.DOE tcode=SUIM report=RSUSR002 selection="Profile = SAP_ALL" rows_returned=11
detection: SUIM/RSUSR* execution by non-security accounts, or table reads of USR02, AGR_USERS, AGR_1251 via SE16/RFC_READ_TABLE.

name: SAP system information disclosed to an unauthenticated caller
description: /sap/public/info and similar endpoints return SID, kernel release, client list and database details without authentication. That output is what an attacker uses to select an exploit.
log_sources: SAP ICM / Web Dispatcher Access Log
sample_log:
203.0.113.45 - - [29/Oct/2026:11:40:02 +0000] "GET /sap/public/info HTTP/1.1" 200 2418 "-" "python-requests/2.31.0"
# response: <rfcproto>011</rfcproto><rfcchartyp>4103</rfcchartyp><rfcdest>PRD_00</rfcdest><rfckernrl>753</rfckernrl>
detection: HTTP 200 on /sap/public/info, /sap/public/icman, /sap/bc/ping from external sources; should be blocked at the Web Dispatcher.
